Calstone Light O had finally broken into
a realm unseen in races. And then――
Is it not obvious? In the first place, a race is――

If you let your guard down, Calstone Light O will dash
straight into the distant future at the speed of light. And with her――
I can still go faster! Faster still!!

――?! Trainer, are you certain?
Where do we go from here...

Calstone Light O takes off, smoothly building up speed.
And――from here, it begins now.

It's instinct, pure instinct. If wanting to beat other Umamusume is instinct,
then wanting to push velocity to its absolute limit is instinct too. Quite natural, wouldn't you say?

Agnes Tachyon had a point. Races are an artificial construct,
and there is no need to deny something simply because it doesn't fit into one.

I felt that the true essence of Calstone Light O's running
could never be understood unless observed under those exact conditions.

I understood her policy completely. But dropping out of
the Twinkle Series meant giving up on becoming the fastest in history. In that case――
I want to hug you and break into a joyous victory dance!

To the pinnacle of all living beings!
Oooooooooooh――!!

I was utterly captivated and drawn in by Calstone Light O's running.
That much was unmistakably clear.

Fundamentally, we have no need to be bound by such constraints.
Indeed, maximum speed is――the dream of science! Innovation! The instinct of our species!

Calstone Light O's desire is sound.
However...
What do I think? ...I find it exceedingly natural.

Some might view it as... distorted.
After all, as an Umamusume, aiming for victory is supposed to be...

Haha, what you choose to do is no concern of mine.
However――

Logic. Yes, what you are spouting is mere logic.
No matter how many of those arguments you line up, they are meaningless.

Maximum speed over immediate victory. If she stays true to demonstrating that conviction,
she might suffer repeated losses and end up eliminated from the Twinkle Series...

Hahaha! I see! "Maximum speed over victory", is it?
Fascinating. To think such an extreme Umamusume existed.

When I told her about Calstone Light O,
the Umamusume, Agnes Tachyon, chuckled with great amusement.

Drills and... competition?
Do you mean training and races?

She had finally reached the limit. It might not yet be the fastest in all of life.
Even so, watching Calstone Light O sprint at full tilt――

In the end, that is what it all boiled down to. But does that mean I should become
her Trainer and support such a purely uncompromising dream, or not...

The simplest format to observe pure running.
Not running along a curved course, but sprinting down a long straight line.
Three years later, at the "Sprinters Stakes".

I must reach it at all costs! The other side of that wall of light!
Therefore――

Ooooooh! At this very moment,
surpassing humans! Surpassing Umamusume! Surpassing every beast on earth!

Indeed. Now, if you'll excuse me. I, too, have matters
that logic alone cannot resolve.
A specific condition? What would that be――

――Understood.
Then I shall demonstrate my limit on the straightaway.

Why do starting gates exist? Why are the distances 1200m or 2400m,
instead of 10,000m or 20,000m? And why...

Unless I faced Calstone Light O's running head-on and determined
what I truly wanted to achieve as a Trainer, I couldn't move forward.

My apologies for being unable to hide it.
However――it's settled then.

Improving speed through self-taught methods reaches its limit here.
To push beyond this point requires a "plan". Which is to say――

(I want to run. I want to sprint. Faster than
every single thing in this world. ――Alright!)

*pant*, *pant*... I cannot run any faster right now.
However――

I understood what Agnes Tachyon meant.
That's right, it isn't about logic――

A miniature garden. Yes, that's all it is. Nothing more than a box of rules
crafted by someone for their own convenience.

Hone her speed while making the necessary adjustments so she can win in the Twinkle Series.
That was my job as her Trainer.

Compete in races.
I have no objection to that, but there is one problem...

I will pursue it to the very ends of the earth. The ultimate dream no one else sees:
"Just how fast can an Umamusume run?"

Adapting to given conditions is commendable.
However, condemning natural instinct is utter nonsense.

"Drills" grounded in precise analysis. "Competition" against other Umamusume.
Without those, the path forward will not open.
Haaaaaaah!

Logic. Yes, what you are spouting is mere logic.
No matter how many of those arguments you line up, they are meaningless.

Agnes Tachyon walked away. Much of what she said was too difficult
and complex to fully grasp. Yet, even so, what came to mind was...

Courses have curves, so Umamusume must turn?
Are those not all artificial constraints imposed purely for physical convenience?

Aaaaaaaagh!! This is――my current limit.
Yet one day, I shall go beyond this light!!

Trainer...
If I were to describe how I feel right now――

"You want to see my running once more?" I do not mind, but...
why go through the trouble of renting such a massive course?
